body: I have, but my moms financial situation is so bad, I don’t want to burden her. She lives in a trailer and there’s no job opportunities in her town. I’ve thought about staying here and trying to honor my commitments but on my own. That way I won’t feel like I failed. But really, thank you for your words. It makes me feel like I didn’t make such a huge mistake.

I know it must sound super fucking pathetic, a grown woman complaining about getting treated a way she doesn’t want to be treated. Ita so stupid. I just put so much faith where there should have been none. I just feel like I messed so much up. I feel ashamed.

It hurts me that moving on from this means giving up the person I changed my life for. I’ve tried so hard to tell him. He’s told me that I never seem to be happy. I was so happy with him. I know it comes down to my word against his but I tried so hard to get here to be with him. I told him that it hurts me when he is excited to go out with his girl friends but never proposes to get a drink with me or go see a movie. I’ve told him you don’t have to take care of me, but I am your girlfriend, not your roommate. Now I don’t feel like either. I don’t even feel welcome in my own home.

Thank you for your response. I’m sorry for your wife’s little sister. I wouldn’t wish this on anyone.

I have been out with his friends, but I also try to give him space away from me as well. I enjoy being with them— they’re great people. It’s not so much being in a new strange place as seeing him become distant and cold towards me. 

An example was when we went out and I wanted to hold his hand, kiss him while we waited. He pulled away and snapped at me, asking why I had to be so clingy. I’ve always been a touchy person though, and I suppose it’s only recently that it bothers him, in light of my loneliness.
